abilities.desc_zh:
基础远程攻击命中时100%概率驱散1个护甲、近战或者攻击增益。
成功驱散时造成攻击力95%的即时震击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Null Ray

abilities.desc_zh: 20%的概率机规避近战重击。//无图标，天然技能，在敌人近战重击即将命中时计算概率
abilities.desc_en: {{var_4}} chance Starscream Evades Heavy Melee Attacks, because sometimes, cowards do survive.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程普通攻击有70%驱散任何类型的增益，除了来自模块或增益道具的增益。
abilities.desc_en:
Nullify All Hope
Starscream’s cunning is without limits, eventually he will find a way to nullify any advantage an opponent has.
Starscream’s Null Ray has a {{var_8}} chance to Nullify any type of Buff. This does not affect Buffs from Modules or Boosts.
approximately +{{var_9}} per level

abilities.desc_zh: 驱散5个任意类型的增益。
abilities.desc_en: Cunning Treachery - He’s got you now!

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_16}}~{{var_17}} 伤害和 {{var_18}}~{{var_19}} 所有霸天虎远程攻击的穿甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_16}}~{{var_17}} Damage and {{var_18}}~{{var_19}} Armor Piercing for all Decepticon Ranged Attacks.
+{{var_20}}~{{var_21}} Anti-Evade
+{{var_22}}~{{var_23}} Attack Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天获得新能力，他的副官获得+{{var_24}}~{{var_25}}装甲和+{{var_26}}~{{var_27}}攻击评级。
abilities.desc_en: Megatron gains new abilities and his Lieutenants gain +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} Armor and +{{var_26}}~{{var_27}} Attack Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天的特殊技有 {{var_28}}~{{var_29}}% 的几率使对手昏迷 {{var_30}}。此效果每次特殊技每场战斗只会触发一次，且此眩晕减益无法融合。
abilities.desc_en: Megatron’s Special Attacks have a {{var_28}}~{{var_29}}% chance to Stun the opponent for {{var_30}}. This effect will only trigger once per fight for each Special Attack and this Stun debuff cannot be Fused.

abilities.desc_zh: 通过 {{var_31}}~{{var_32}} 增加适时格挡的天火眩晕持续时间。
abilities.desc_en: Increases the duration of Jetfire's Stun for well-timed Blocks by {{var_31}}~{{var_32}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 猛冲回来时，远程攻击会错过红蜘蛛，这会为他提供 {{var_33}}~{{var_34}} 暴击伤害增益，以及 {{var_35}}。
abilities.desc_en: Old Friends – Jetfire - While Dashing Back, Ranged Attacks miss Starscream, which grants him a {{var_33}}~{{var_34}} Crit Damage buff for {{var_35}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 作为防止背叛的卫士，所有下层队友都会获得+{{var_36}} 无效抵抗力。
abilities.desc_en: Acting as a guard against treachery, all lower tier teammates gain +{{var_36}} Nullify Resistance.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_37}}~{{var_38}} 以空中替代形式攻击机器人。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_37}}~{{var_38}} Attack against bots with an Aerial alternate form.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击命中时有20%几率造成燃烧，施加攻击力40%的伤害，持续4秒。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: Double Missile Attack has +{{var_4}} chance to inflict Burn.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程普通攻击暴击几率提升40%
远程伤害提升70%，远程射速提升40%，持续10秒
abilities.desc_en:
//Arcee shows off with a bit of flair; never missing while upside-down in mid-air.

Increases Ranged Damage by 35% and Ranged Speed by 20%, for 6.5 seconds.

abilities.desc_en: Last hit 100% inflicts 35% Armor Break for 7s (increases to 50% vs Brawlers).

abilities.desc_zh: 消除对手身上的增益效果，使其增益立即失效。
abilities.desc_en: Clears active buffs from the opponent, instantly ending their effects.

abilities.desc_zh: 持续造成能量伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Deals energy damage over time.

abilities.desc_zh: 移除护甲增益，降低护甲评级并提升受到攻击的伤害量。
abilities.desc_en: Removes armor buffs and reduces armor rating, amplifying incoming damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 临时增加远程攻击的速度、射击频率与伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Temporarily increases ranged attack speed and damage.
